executive-meeting.alt: Lindiwe reviews the evidence for a business decision; Daniel's administrative role does not transfer her authority.

daniel-desk.alt: Daniel checks the diary against the meeting pack so that preparation, inputs and timing fit together.

authority-review.alt: Thandi checks the protective arrangements separately from the executive's business preference.

aisha-deputy.alt: Aisha reviews the specified cover assignment and the period she is being asked to accept.

finance-operations.alt: Finance and operations check their separate papers together before Daniel assembles the decision pack.

control-room.alt: The independent control-room team checks its own service log and monitoring scope; involvement must be agreed for the assignment.

partnership.alt: Daniel presents the support brief to Lindiwe so that administrative planning serves her business purpose without replacing her decision.

handover.alt: Daniel and Aisha check the specified duties, period and access together; naming a deputy alone does not establish accepted cover.

privacy-screen.alt: Daniel protects private diary information while keeping legitimate administrative work moving.

diary-conflict.alt: Daniel cross-checks a paper planner and electronic diary. The precise fictional times are supplied in the adjacent teaching timeline, not in this illustrative image.

planning-system.alt: Daniel and Lindiwe stand beside a wall of connected planning cards, discussing how work depends on other tasks.

request-unknown.alt: Daniel pauses in the office lobby to examine an incoming request on his phone before making a commitment.

ready-pack.alt: Daniel's hands assemble a meeting pack with one document position still empty; a separate invitation lies beside it.

role-boundaries.alt: Daniel consults the finance contributor at her office doorway while she checks her own folder.

message-correction.alt: Daniel compares a muted previous document with a revised attachment and its accompanying message on his laptop.

four-conditions.alt: Daniel checks a folder at a worktop with a reference manual, an individual access card, a laptop and a capacity planner.

purchase-limit.alt: Daniel checks a single supplies order beside a trolley of consumables in the storeroom.

options-comparison.alt: Daniel and Lindiwe compare three separate proposal sheets laid out side by side before any decision is confirmed.

decision-writing.alt: Daniel composes a structured one-page priority brief, keeping source messages and a retained draft folder separate.

agreement-boundaries.alt: Daniel indicates an uncompleted confirmation section in a divided working-agreement binder while Lindiwe checks a separate delegation folder; nobody signs.

clause-review.alt: Close-up of Daniel querying a vague clause and comparing it with a structured multi-field draft on a separate sheet; no approval is indicated.

deputy-acceptance.alt: Aisha checks an assignment sheet against her calendar while on a headset at her own workstation; her individual access card is visible and acceptance is not implied.

later-evidence.alt: Overhead view of Daniel keeping an earlier grey folder closed and separate from a current teal-tabbed folder with a referenced paper and attached message.

competing-reports.alt: Daniel weighs two separate report folders and task cards against an open capacity planner, with no extra support present.

partnership-review.alt: Standing beside a simple review-cycle whiteboard, Daniel points to a work-product example while Lindiwe considers the evidence; no approval or promise is depicted.

selectionRule: No keyword/default photograph. Each image is selected from exact lesson text and has one UI placement. Role anchors illustrate only the selected named role. No photographs in quiz/outcomes/takeaways; later evidence stays gated.
